title: Lyft and Baidu enter London's robotaxi battleground as testing begins | TechCrunch
summary: Chinese tech giant Baidu has started testing autonomous vehicles in London as part of its partnership with Lyft and Freenow, the German taxi and multi-mobility app that Lyft now owns.
